title: sec.text.v1
description: One block of narrative text extracted from an SEC filing. Kafka message key is the CIK, matching sec.filings.v1.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumping this means a new topic, not a new value here.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, zero-padded to exactly 10 digits. Joins to sec.filings.v1.

ticker.description: Uppercase ticker. Null when the CIK maps to no listed ticker.

accession_no.description: Accession number of the filing this text came from, dashed form. Joins to sec.filings.v1.

form_type.description: Form type of the parent filing, e.g. 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q.

filed_date.description: Date the SEC accepted the parent filing, YYYY-MM-DD. This is the date to join against price bars: an earnings 8-K lands on the day the stock reacts.

section.description: Which part of the filing this text is. Only press_release is produced today; risk_factors and mda are reserved so adding them later is not a contract change.

source_document.description: The filing attachment the text came from, e.g. EX-99.1. Null when the text came from the primary document rather than an exhibit.

title.description: Headline of the document, e.g. 'Apple reports third quarter results'. Null when no heading could be identified. For display only - never parse meaning out of it.

text.description: The narrative text itself, plain text with HTML stripped and whitespace collapsed. Never empty: a section with no text is not emitted at all.

chunk_index.description: 0-based position of this chunk within the section. Always 0 for documents that fit in one message.

chunk_total.description: Total number of chunks the section was split into. Always 1 for documents that fit in one message. Present from day one so that splitting long sections later is not a contract change.

ingested_at.description: When the producer emitted this message, ISO 8601 UTC with a trailing Z.
